about.description: iShares MSCI South Korea ETF (EWY) perpetual on Lighter. Tracks NYSE Arca: EWY, a Korea-exposure ETF managed by BlackRock, USDC-margined. Lighter previously offered the Korean Composite Index (KRCOMP) perp as their Korean-equities exposure instrument. That market is now delisted and replaced by this EWY ETF perp.
